actions: Deploy NAS security mode extension (SME) to enforce strict IMSI attachment rules.
Set NAS security mode counter to 3+ for all UEs to block unauthorized NAS messages.
Enable NAS trace filtering with NAS-EPS-EMM-128EEA1 threshold at 100+ for alerts.
Configure RAN to reject NAS messages from unknown eNB/gNB IEs.
Implement NAS integrity protection with NAS-MAP-ALLOWLIST for trusted IMSIs.
Enforce NAS timer T3450 (reauthentication) at 10-minute intervals for suspicious UEs.
Block NAS messages with NAS-EPS-EMM-128EEA1 > 120 via core policy rules.
Deploy NAS-based UE context validation to verify eNB/gNB legitimacy.
Enable NAS-based emergency-only mode enforcement for non-registered UEs.
Monitor NAS message frequency per UE with a 5-message/second counter for anomalies.

mapped_mitigations.fgm_name: Discard RAN Signaling Received Without Integrity Protection
